environment.mapping: Official Quartus II analysis/export; original VQM and adapter audit retained

definitions.latency_main: R119: first app_tx valid cycle of the message -> last byte delivered on app_rx (L_entry_last); backpressure before the first handshake is included
definitions.latency_first: first app_tx valid cycle -> first delivered byte (L_entry_first)
definitions.jitter: R119-2: max-min of L_entry_last inside one (VL, identical frame length) group, maximum over groups
definitions.injection: R120-1: payload bytes handshaken at the application transmit port inside the window / window duration
definitions.injection_judgement: inject >=100 Mbps where gated, dropped=overflow=duplicate=0, first-valid lag <=1471 cycles; var_burst uses max(planned release, previous message final input byte +1), all other stages use planned release; raw planned-release lag is retained separately
definitions.legacy_superseded: L_gmii (GMII SFD to SFD) and L_app/L_app_last (application last-byte submission) are kept as supplements; the R97-1 GMII definition was replaced by R119
definitions.window: gbe77/var_* use the F begin/end window of each stage; the application entry default uses 1000..4000 us

policy.latency: L_entry_last <= 2000 us for every measured frame, including warmup and drain
policy.jitter: Each var_* value is reported and checked against the project checker line of 50 us; this is not an official upper limit
policy.throughput: R120-1 gates at 100 Mbps at the application transmit port; var_high and the app entry must pass, other var_* stages report the offered load
policy.resources: R122: resource usage is not scored
